perspective:
From SEEKER’s perspective:

- I greeted RECOMMENDER with “Hello...Happy New Year...” and asked if they knew any new comedy movies out.
- I said I want to see *A Bad Moms Christmas* (2017), but it isn’t on Amazon yet.
- RECOMMENDER told me *Girls Trip* (2017) was funny, and so was *Baywatch* (2017).
- I have seen *Girls Trip* (2017) and thought it was funny.
- I have not seen *Baywatch* (2017), but I heard it received bad reviews.
- RECOMMENDER told me *Daddy’s Home 2* (2017) is out now, and that they enjoyed *Daddy’s Home* (2015).
- I said that might be one to consider because I liked the first one a lot.
- RECOMMENDER then said *Baywatch* wasn’t too popular, but it has nice eye candy, makes you think of summer, and the plot was really dumb.
